wall_gaps: ReadPerimeter(st, home): Area ha = home.areaManager.Home; foreach (IntVec3 c in ha.ActiveCells) { bool edge = GenAdj.CardinalDirections.Any(d => { IntVec3 n = c + d; return !n.InBounds(home) || !ha[n]; }); if (!edge) continue; Building ed = c.GetEdifice(home); bool closed = ed != null && (IsWallDef(ed.def) || ed is Building_Door || ed.def.defName.Contains("Embrasure")); if (!closed && c.Walkable(home)) gaps++; } st["wall_gaps"] = (double)gaps;
unpowered_consumers: foreach (Building b in home.listerBuildings.allBuildingsColonist) { CompPowerTrader pt = b.TryGetComp<CompPowerTrader>(); if (pt == null || pt.PowerOutput > 0) continue; if (pt.PowerNet == null) unpoweredConsumers++; } st["unpowered_consumers"] = (double)unpoweredConsumers;
power_margin_pct: same loop: if (pt.PowerOutput > 0) produced += pt.PowerOutput; else consumed += -pt.PowerOutput; if (consumed > 0) st["power_margin_pct"] = Math.Round(produced / consumed * 100.0, 0);
torch_lamps: st["torch_lamps"] = (double)CountBuilt(home, "TorchLamp"); // CountBuilt: ThingDef d = DefDatabase<ThingDef>.GetNamedSilentFail(defName); return d == null ? 0 : map.listerBuildings.AllBuildingsColonistOfDef(d).Count();
colonists_without_bedroom: foreach (Pawn p in home.mapPawns.FreeColonistsSpawned) { Room own = p.ownership?.OwnedRoom; Building_Bed bed = p.ownership?.OwnedBed; if (bed == null || bed.ForPrisoners || own == null) noBedroom++; } st["colonists_without_bedroom"] = (double)noBedroom;
rooms_out_of_temp: foreach (Room r in home.regionGrid.AllRooms) { if (r.PsychologicallyOutdoors || r.IsDoorway || !r.ProperRoom || r.Role == null || r.Role == RoomRoleDefOf.None) continue; float t = r.Temperature; if (t < 10f || t > 35f) outOfTemp++; } st["rooms_out_of_temp"] = (double)outOfTemp;
room_wall_holes: same room loop: if (r.OpenRoofCount > 0) holes++; st["room_wall_holes"] = (double)holes;
unfloored_room_cells: same room loop: foreach (IntVec3 c in r.Cells) { TerrainDef td = c.GetTerrain(home); if (!td.IsFloor || td.natural) unfloored++; } st["unfloored_room_cells"] = (double)unfloored;
camp_water_cells: Area homeArea = home.areaManager.Home; if (homeArea != null) st["camp_water_cells"] = (double)homeArea.ActiveCells.Count(c => { TerrainDef td = home.terrainGrid.TerrainAt(c); return td.IsWater || td.defName.Contains("Marsh") || td.defName.Contains("Mud"); });
blueprints_against_rock: st["blueprints_against_rock"] = (double)home.listerThings.ThingsInGroup(ThingRequestGroup.Blueprint).Count(bp => bp.def.entityDefToBuild is ThingDef ed && IsWallDef(ed) && GenAdj.CardinalDirections.Any(d => { IntVec3 n = bp.Position + d; return n.InBounds(home) && n.GetEdifice(home)?.def.mineable == true; }));
